summary.en: Carry on a conversation with @question and hand it to your coding agent, follow up on any result with ⇧⏎, change settings by describing them with @config, check your setup with @doctor, add extensions from Git, and use Bedrock with SSO, role and credential_process profiles that refresh on their own.
summary.zh: @question 可以连续追问，并交给你的编程助手接着聊；任何 AI 结果都能用 ⇧⏎ 追问；用 @config 一句话改设置，用 @doctor 检查配置；可以从 Git 添加扩展；Bedrock 支持 SSO、角色和 credential_process，凭证自动刷新。
